ei.title: When Space Enters the Sound's Route

fullPassage: Rooms have their own "sound" because they impose their own characteristics on audio signals contained within them. It's actually kind of remarkable. Sound such as music coming from headphones will sound the same everywhere. No matter what acoustical environment we are in, the headphones sound the same. That's because the room is not part of that playback signal path. But sound such as music from a loudspeaker will sound different in every acoustical environment. Every room where you set up the loudspeaker will cause the sound you hear to be different—sometimes dramatically different; that is because the room is now part of the signal path. Also, in the same room, the loudspeaker will sound different when it is placed in different locations in the room and it will sound different as you move around the room. Similarly, when you are recording a musical instrument, the sound you receive at the microphone will be different in every room and the recorded sound will sound different as the instrument or the microphone is moved.

questions.passage: Rooms have their own "sound" because they impose their own characteristics on audio signals ①<u>containing</u> within them. It's actually kind of remarkable. Sound such as music ②<u>coming</u> from headphones will sound the same everywhere. No matter what acoustical environment we ③<u>are</u> in, the headphones ④<u>sound</u> the same.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① containing → contained: audio signals가 '포함되는' 것이므로 과거분사(수동).
det.analysis:
❌ ① containing → contained: signals are contained (수동)
✅ ② coming: music coming from headphones (능동 분사)
✅ ③ are: we are in 적절
✅ ④ sound: headphones sound (복수 주어 + 동사원형)
det.tip: contained(포함된, 수동) vs containing(포함하는, 능동)

questions.passage: But sound such as music from a loudspeaker will sound different in every acoustical environment. Every room ①<u>which</u> you set up the loudspeaker will cause the sound you hear ②<u>to be</u> different—sometimes dramatically different; that is because the room is now part of the ③<u>signal</u> ④<u>path</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① which → where: Every room where you set up — 장소 관계부사.
det.analysis:
❌ ① which → where: room(장소) + set up in → 관계부사 where
✅ ② to be: cause O to V 적절
✅ ③ signal: 명사 수식 적절
✅ ④ path: 명사 적절
det.tip: where = in which | 장소 선행사 + 관계부사 where

questions.passage: Also, in the same room, the loudspeaker will sound different when it ①<u>is placed</u> in different locations. Similarly, when you are recording a musical instrument, the sound you ②<u>receive</u> at the microphone will ③<u>be</u> different in every room and the recorded sound will sound different as the instrument or the microphone ④<u>are moved</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ are moved → is moved: 'the instrument or the microphone'에서 or로 연결된 주어는 가까운 명사(the microphone, 단수)에 수를 일치.
det.analysis:
✅ ① is placed: 수동태 적절
✅ ② receive: you receive 적절
✅ ③ be: will be different 적절
❌ ④ are moved → is moved: or 연결 시 가까운 주어에 일치
det.tip: A or B + 동사 → B에 수 일치 | the microphone(단수) → is moved

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ acoustically → acoustical: environment(명사)를 수식하므로 형용사가 필요.
det.analysis:
✅ ① such as: 예시 표현 적절
✅ ② that: 지시형용사 적절

questions.passage: Rooms have their own "sound" because they impose their own characteristics on audio signals contained within them. Sound from headphones will sound the same everywhere. That's because the room is not part of that playback __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 방은 신호 경로(signal path)의 일부가 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ signal path(신호 경로): 원문 일치
❌ ① sound wave(음파): 다른 표현
❌ ② music genre(음악 장르): 무관
❌ ④ volume level(음량 수준): 무관
det.tip: signal path = 신호 경로 = 소리가 전달되는 경로

questions.passage: Rooms have their own "sound" because they impose their own characteristics on audio signals contained within them. It's actually kind of ①<u>remarkable</u>. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ excluded from(배제된) → part of(일부인): 방이 신호 경로의 '일부'이기 때문에 소리가 달라진다.

✅ ① remarkable(놀라운): 원문 일치
✅ ② same(같은): 원문 일치
✅ ③ playback(재생): 원문 일치
❌ ④ excluded from(배제된): 원문은 part of(일부) — 반대 의미

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

❌ ③ blocking the audio signals: 문맥과 다름
❌ ④ amplifying the headphones: 헤드폰과 무관
